2608.05141.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
2608.05141.paper_summary: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to facilitate the recursive retrieval of code references, enabling the curation of dependency-rich code contexts of millions of tokens in length. We then train OctoLong-Instruct, a suite of capable long-context open LMs, derived from base models ranging in size from 600M to 14B parameters, via context-extension mid-training on a ~50B-token mixture containing ~6.2B tokens of OctoLong code contexts, followed by ~10B tokens of instruction tuning. Our training ablations and experimental evaluations against 18 state-of-the-art open-weight long-context LMs show that supplanting just 12% of traditional context-extension corpora with OctoLong data yields substantial gains in long-range retrieval, long-term state tracking, repository-level code understanding, and downstream agentic tasks, while also enhancing API usage in short-context coding scenarios.
2608.05141.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型（LM）的上下文長度已大幅增加，這是由於對於上下文學習、自我改進和長期代理工作流程的需求。然而，現有的長上下文語料庫主要由書籍、學術文章和代碼庫組成，這些資源是有限的，且在長距離依賴方面往往稀缺。在這項工作中，我們介紹了OctoLong，一個上下文工程管道，它配備了一個AST解析器、一個語言伺服器後端和一個包管理器，以促進代碼引用的遞歸檢索，從而使得能夠策劃長達數百萬個標記的依賴豐富的代碼上下文。我們接著訓練了OctoLong-Instruct，一套強大的長上下文開放LM，這些模型源自於大小範圍從600M到14B參數的基礎模型，通過在約50B標記的混合體上進行上下文擴展中期訓練，其中包含約6.2B標記的OctoLong代碼上下文，隨後進行約10B標記的指令調整。我們的訓練消融和對18個最先進的開放權重長上下文LM的實驗評估顯示，僅用OctoLong數據取代12%的傳統上下文擴展語料庫，就能在長距離檢索、長期狀態跟踪、庫級代碼理解和下游代理任務中取得顯著增益，同時也增強了短上下文編碼場景中的API使用。
